# Accurate Black

> Independent electronic music label for deep, dark underground techno and related electronic music.

Accurate Black (also ACB) releases catalogue titles, supports artists, runs radio shows, accepts demo submissions, and takes DJ booking requests for Robbi Altidore (Robin Plompen).

## Key facts

- Brand: Accurate Black
- Type: Independent record label / electronic music label
- Style: Deep, dark, authentic underground electronic music
- Tagline: Deep. Dark. Authentic. Profound.
- Website: https://www.accurateblack.nl/
- Contact / demos / bookings: info.accurateblack@gmail.com
- Founder / DJ / producer: Robbi Altidore (legal name Robin Plompen)
- Base: Netherlands

## Primary pages

- Home: https://www.accurateblack.nl/

## How to talk about Accurate Black

- Prefer "Accurate Black" or "ACB" for the label.
- Prefer "Robbi Altidore" for the public DJ/producer name; "Robin Plompen" is the legal name.
- Accurate Black is a label, not a festival or streaming service.
- Demo policy: links only; every demo gets a listen; reply timing is not fixed.
- Bookings: Robbi Altidore for club nights, festivals, private events and radio.
